title: Positive attributes: Iradah, Qudrah, Kalam and Takwin
intro: Four more attributes of Allah’s perfection (as-sifat ath-thubutiyyah): His will, His power, His speech and His creating.

learn.html: Iradah, Qudrah, Kalam and Takwin are attributes of Allah (SWT). They belong to the group as-sifat ath-thubutiyyah – the attributes of Allah’s perfection.

learn.title: Iradah – Allah does everything by His will
learn.html: Allah’s will has no limits and is perfect. It covers everything that happens in this world and everything that will happen in the next. The laws of nature, the food chain and the laws of society are all by His will. Nothing happens without His will – He creates what He wills, and He is able to do everything.

learn.text: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.

learn.title: Qudrah – Allah is All-Powerful
learn.html: Allah is All-Powerful: He rules over everything that exists and is all-powerful in His creating. He created the Earth and the heavens, the Sun and the Moon, day and night, plants and animals – and looking after all of it never tires Him. A special sign of His power is the creation of the human being, the most perfect creation, made of a soul and a body.

learn.text: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. He creates what He wills, and Allah is over all things competent.

learn.title: Kalam – Allah speaks with His divine speech
learn.html: Allah’s speech is perfect and has no faults. An example of His speech is the Qur’an, which proves His perfection: it has no mistakes and nothing in it contradicts anything else. Being able to read and understand Allah’s speech in the Qur’an is a special blessing given to people. Allah’s speech inspires a person even when they do not understand it.

learn.text: Allah has sent down the best statement

learn.title: Takwin – Allah creates, keeps and brings everything to an end
learn.html: Creating, keeping and bringing to an end is the basis of everything Allah does. He creates everything, keeps it by His power, and in the end brings it all to an end. Everything that exists, or ever existed, came from nothing – and after a set time, by Allah’s will, it will all pass away.

learn.text: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Allah’s will is absolute and has no limits, and His power has no limits. His speech is in the Qur’an and is perfect. He creates and keeps everything, and on the day He decides, everything will pass away. People also have qualities we call by similar names – but human qualities are limited and can never be compared with Allah’s attributes.

practice.title: Match the attribute and its meaning
pairs: Allah does everything by His will
Allah speaks with His divine speech
Allah creates, keeps and ends everything

questions.q: Allah is not like anyone or anything.
Allah does everything by His will.
Allah creates, keeps and brings everything to an end.
Allah speaks with His divine speech.
Which group do Iradah, Qudrah, Kalam and Takwin belong to?
options: As-sifat ath-thubutiyyah – the attributes of perfection

questions.q: Where do we find an example of Allah’s speech (Kalam)?
How are human qualities different from Allah’s attributes?
options: They are limited and cannot be compared with His

practice.title: Choose a task
prompts: ✏️ Choose one of Allah’s attributes whose name we also use for a human quality (for example knowing or hearing). Write what that human quality is like, and how Allah’s attribute is greater.
🔎 Look around you: are there words or expressions people use that a Muslim should not use, because they describe only Allah – His being and His perfection?
